study type: Cohort study using a natural experiment
exposure: Mothers with at least two births
outcome: Maternal weight prior to the second pregnancy
Maternal BMI prior to the second pregnancy
Movement to a higher BMI classification prior to the second pregnancy
cohort: Mothers with at least two births in Wisconsin from 2006 to 2013
finding: After accounting for correlations between pre-pregnancy weight, gestational weight gain, and mode of delivery, there is no evidence of a causal link between Cesarean delivery and maternal weight retention.
mod_finding: The study found no causal link between cesarean delivery and greater maternal weight, BMI, or movement to a higher BMI classification prior to a subsequent pregnancy.
